entities.description: A close-up view of a pair of wrinkled, elderly hands with visible veins and age spots, cupped together to receive a small, bright orange poppy held by a smaller, smoother hand. The elderly person wears a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt, while the smaller hand, likely belonging to a child, wears a simple gold ring on the ring finger.

A close-up view of a young child's hand with light skin tone gently grasping the thin green stem of a plant. The child's hand is positioned in the foreground, while a larger, weathered adult hand with visible wrinkles and tanned skin is visible in the background, appearing to guide or support the child's grip.

A close-up of a very old, weathered hand with deep wrinkles and brownish skin tone, showing signs of age and labor, with a younger hand gently holding it. The background is a blurred sandy beige, suggesting an outdoor desert setting.
